what_worked.title: Primary-Source Receipts Drive 2.4x Longer Transcript Engagement
what_worked.evidence: 214 clicks on timestamped source receipts (.source-card / a.cite) across 428 /episodes/ views (50.0% receipt interaction rate).
what_worked.takeaway: Keep leading social threads with a concrete verifiable claim + timestamped primary-source receipt rather than generic episode summaries.

what_worked.title: Radical Cost Transparency (/ledger/) Converts Curiosity into Support Intent
what_worked.evidence: 164 views on /ledger/ generated 22 of the 29 total donation button clicks (13.4% click-through rate across Stripe, Crypto, and PayPal).
what_worked.takeaway: Link /ledger/ directly beneath every episode player and inside weekly X/Bluesky threads showing exact TTS + LLM production cost ($4.53 total for Ep 001 + Ep 002).

what_worked.title: Native Multilingual Dubs Expand Non-English Reach to 32.4% of Views
what_worked.evidence: 597 pageviews and 144 full-episode audio plays came from the 7 translated locales (led by Español at 9.9% and Deutsch at 5.6%).
what_worked.takeaway: Publish localized audiogram clips alongside English clips on X and Bluesky for each new episode release.

what_to_improve.title: Browser-to-RSS Subscription Conversion on Mobile
what_to_improve.evidence: While 462 visitors played audio in-browser, only 74 clicked an RSS / Apple Podcasts / Spotify subscribe link (16.0%).
what_to_improve.takeaway: Keep one-tap Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and Copy RSS buttons visible directly in the sticky player and episode hero.
